dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, when is your trip to Chiang Mai?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈwɛn ɪz jʊr ˈtrɪp tə ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: The day after tomorrow! When are you going to go home to Canada?
dialogue.reading: ðə ˈdeɪ ˈæftər təˈmɑːroʊ! ˈwɛn ər juː ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈɡoʊ ˈhoʊm tə ˈkænədə?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: In two weeks, for the holidays.
dialogue.reading: ɪn ˈtuː ˈwiːks, fər ðə ˈhɑːlədeɪz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: How long are you going to stay there?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaʊ ˈlɔːŋ ər juː ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈsteɪ ˈðɛr?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Three weeks. Then I'm going to return for my last semester.
dialogue.reading: ˈθriː ˈwiːks. ˈðɛn aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə rɪˈtɜːrn fər maɪ ˈlæst səˈmɛstər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: And what are your plans for the future?
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈwʌt ər jʊr ˈplænz fər ðə ˈfjuːtʃər?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: This time next year, I'm going to work in Bangkok!
dialogue.reading: ðɪs ˈtaɪm ˈnɛkst ˈjɪr, aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈwɜːrk ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Great! And someday, I'm going to visit Canada.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt! ənd ˈsʌmdeɪ, aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈvɪzɪt ˈkænədə.
